## What
- Built-in profile `codex`: `codex exec -C {worktree} --sandbox workspace-write --output-schema .agents/skills/kanban/schema/terminal.json "{prompt}"`, worktree created by the dispatcher (`git worktree add`).
- `hkb init --harness codex` generates `.codex/hooks.json` (Stop → `hkb hook stop`) and appends `[mcp_servers]`-free config notes; write `docs/harnesses.md` with the exact one-time trust steps (`/hooks`, project `trust_level`) verified against https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks and the config reference.
- Reuse the same template mechanism as the copilot profile (coordinate through the run comment of that task if it merged first: read its summary).

## Done when
Generated files exist, `hkb doctor` reports the profile, docs are accurate to the current Codex docs (cite URLs in the PR).
title: codex profile: codex exec --output-schema in a worktree, .codex/hooks.json Stop nudge, documented one-time trust
